assignments.node_id: שכבר נלכד בזה, ויש לו אלו המחשבות, הן הרהורי זנות, הן הרהורי עבודה זרה, חס ושלום
assignments.reason: This node describes the state of being trapped in evil thoughts — hirhurei znut (lustful thoughts) and hirhurei avoda zara (idolatrous thoughts). Its essential nature is the manifestation of the yetzer hara at the lower/physical level. Torah #72 explicitly equates hirhurei znut with hirhurei avoda zara (both are shtut/folly born of turbid blood), and the bechina edge נשין שפירין ↔ אלילים in Package 1 captures exactly this equivalence. This node is the experiential state of being caught in that domain — the person afflicted by the lower yetzer hara of coarse blood and dimyonot (fantasies). Its essential nature places it squarely in the evil inclination package.

unassigned_nodes.node_id: שיקדש ויטהר גופו, כדי שיזדכך ויטהר דמיו. וילך אצל חכם האמת, ויורה לו דרכי התשובה, דרכי החכמה, עצות נכונות על כל דבר
unassigned_nodes.reason: This node's essential nature is kedushah (sanctification), taharah (purification), teshuvah (repentance), and chochmah (wisdom received from the true sage). These are all good-domain concepts. The only existing package in Torah #72 is Package 1 (יצר הרע), which is an evil-polarity package. Assigning a fundamentally good/holy concept — the remedy of bodily purification, going to the chacham ha'emet, and receiving paths of wisdom and repentance — to the evil inclination package would violate the principle of assignment by essential nature. This node represents the tikun (rectification) for the yetzer hara, not an aspect of the yetzer hara itself. No good-domain bechina package exists in Torah #72's current package structure to house it. It would naturally anchor a good package such as 'תְּשׁוּבָה וְחָכְמָה — Repentance and Wisdom' or 'קִדּוּשׁ הַגּוּף — Sanctification of the Body', but creating such a package requires bechina edges that are not present in the dataset for this Torah.
